'''Masakazu Morita''' (Japanese: '''森田成一''' ''Morita Masakazu'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Morita was born on October 21, 1972, in {{wp|Sumida, Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}; and he became an actor, voice actor, and singer as an adult. He was affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Aoni Production}} and was well-known for a number of roles in several anime series. Morita provided his voice for [[Chili]], one of the three [[Striaton City]] [[Gym Leader]]s and brothers, in {{aniseries|BW}}.
